hints.tr: `delay = 0.5`; her başarısız turdan sonra `if attempt < attempts - 1: time.sleep(delay); delay *= 2`.
hints.en: `delay = 0.5`; after each failed round `if attempt < attempts - 1: time.sleep(delay); delay *= 2`.

hints.tr: `try:` içinde istek ve `if r.status_code < 500: return r`; `except (requests.Timeout, requests.ConnectionError): pass`.
hints.en: Inside `try:` the request and `if r.status_code < 500: return r`; `except (requests.Timeout, requests.ConnectionError): pass`.

hint.tr: 404 yeniden denenmemeli: /books/99 için tek istek olmalı.
hint.en: A 404 must not be retried: there should be a single request for /books/99.
